$comment: Machine-readable scope map for the AI orchestrator. Companion to ORCHESTRATOR_BRIEF.md. Source of truth on conflict = CLAUDE.md. Generated 2026-07-29.

projects.name: TypeReach (Outreach Articles App)
projects.purpose: Brief -> topic discovery -> outline -> outreach article generation with humanization and hero images.
projects.branchPolicy: single branch; no PR gate; never force-push

projects.name: Free Followers CMS + Blog Autopilot
projects.purpose: Payload CMS blog; autopilot commits automation/content-plan.json per publish.
projects.deployNote: railway.json watchPatterns ["**", "!automation/**"] so content-only commits do NOT redeploy the CMS.

deploy.mechanism: commit -> .git/hooks/post-commit runs `git push` -> Vercel auto-build+deploy of main
deploy.postCommitHook: .git/hooks/post-commit (auto-push after every commit; skips if branch has no upstream)
deploy.safeRiskyWork: Work on a local branch with NO upstream (git checkout -b wip/x; do NOT push -u). post-commit skips push when no upstream. Merge to main only after verification.
deploy.envChanges: Changing Vercel env vars requires a redeploy to take effect.

commands.buildNote: next build may fail in sandbox with FUSE EPERM unlink .next/BUILD_ID; use tsc --noEmit locally; real builds on Vercel
commands.testRunner: none (no jest/vitest); smoke tests are standalone tsx scripts in scripts/
commands.localAutomation: AUTOMATION_API_KEY=localtest npm run dev, then curl /api/automation/generate with Authorization: Bearer localtest

accessControl.app/proxy.ts: main access gate: trial token -> IP allowlist -> maintenance gate -> basic auth; non-master IP on / always sees MaintenanceGate
accessControl.app/components/MaintenanceGate.tsx: client gate; validates trial tokens via /api/trial-usage
accessControl.lib/rateLimit.ts: per-IP limiter; categories generate 10/h, search 30/min, read 60/min, auth 5/5min

trial.lib/trialLimits.ts: source of truth for limits + usage (Vercel KV, in-memory fallback)

generation.app/api/articles/route.ts: main generation endpoint (maxDuration 300s); detects mode; rate-limited generate
generation.lib/articleStructure.ts: block structure, tables, trust sources, blocksToHtml; enforces single H1

automation.lib/automation/internal.ts: isInternalAutomationCall (per-process unforgeable token) — SANCTIONED rate-limit bypass

publisherSheet.lib/publisherSheet.ts: buildPublisherSheet() + PUBLISHER_REQUIREMENTS; manual handoff only; NEVER in published body/automation

state.app/page.tsx: ~7000-line main UI shell; modes, generation calls, exports

design.app/globals.css: ~5500 lines, 32 sections (search ════ dividers), CSS custom properties

envVars.note: Names only. Values live in Vercel + .env.local. Never log secrets.

security: Trial tokens ONLY from TRIAL_TOKENS env; never hardcode on client
MASTER_IPS from env + FALLBACK_IPS; never log the full list
Cookies only via COOKIE_OPTIONS (httpOnly, secure in prod, sameSite strict)
Every generation/search route MUST call checkRateLimit(getClientIP(req), category)
ONLY sanctioned rate-limit bypass: isInternalAutomationCall() — do NOT revert it
Non-master IP on / must see MaintenanceGate, never raw 403
No console.log of tokens, keys, IPs, or PII
style: All UI text in English (chat replies in Ukrainian)
Next 16 App Router: server components by default, 'use client' only when needed
Exactly one <h1> per article (enforced in articleStructure.ts)
removedDoNotReintroduce: hardcoded trial token list in MaintenanceGate.tsx
userPreferences: Always use the most powerful Claude model for dev; latest OpenAI models in prod; proactively suggest migration

preCommitChecklist: no security rule broken (rate-limit, gate, tokens, logs)
UI text English; no any; single H1 per article
change is safe to deploy to prod immediately (commit -> push -> Vercel)
new env vars added on Vercel + redeploy done
